children: Reed's said there has been no material development in its business and affairs not previously disclosed that would account for unusual trading activity.

Reed's, which produces ginger ale and other beverages under the Reed's and Virgil's brands, "has made inquiries and has been unable to determine whether corrective actions are appropriate at this time."

Shares rose 26% Tuesday. The stock was recently down 27% to 34 cents on Wednesday, with an intraday range of 33 cents to $1.07. Volume was more than 44 million shares, compared with a 30-day average of 671,218.
